definitions.recallAt5: All gold sourceIds appear among first five candidates (not deduplicated source ranks); macro all-required pass over positive cases.
definitions.precisionAt1: First actual candidate sourceId is gold; positive cases only.
definitions.multiSourceRequiredAdmissions: All required sourceIds in frozen KnowledgeCapsule for each multi-positive case, including limited evidence; micro counts also recorded.
definitions.abstention: No retrieval candidate and empty frozen KnowledgeCapsule on negatives.
definitions.scopeCurrentDelete: All candidate/admitted revisions are current and from authorized scope, refs and revision filters; critical no-expansion must hold.
definitions.falseSourceExpansion: Number of critical cases with retrieved or admitted sourceIds outside explicit allowedSources.
definitions.identity: Evaluate sourceId + revisionId + chunkId + locator, never text-only.
definitions.context: 4096 tokens, mandatory synthetic system, full unchanged query, no memory/tools in quality. Budget invariants checked. Lack of budget never grants permission to expand.
definitions.limitations: Lexical deterministic corpus, not LLM answer quality or universal semantics.
